descriptionMarkdown:
A set of combinators to ensure loading and unloading are balanced. IE., When a station of a same name has more resources than another, this combination will ensure that a station buffer containing more resources for loading or fewer resources for unloading has a higher priority over others. Works best with multiple stations in close proximity.

Instructions as follows:

Use `<` for loading, `>` for unloading.

Red from arithmetic out to power poles (isolated net) to send resource * ID for comparison.

Red from decider out to station to set priority.

Green/red from buffer direct to arithmetic input to provide resource amount.

Constant combinator ensures signal exists; no signal breaks logic.

Set resource and order (virtual signal) per station.

`Train condition: (resource) = 0`
title: Multi Station Load/Unload Balancer/Selector
